lines.text: Wait! A mosquito doesn't actually bite you!
Inside that tiny bug's mouth hide 6 ultra-thin needles!
When she lands quietly on your arm...
she spits invisible saliva right inside your skin first!
Why? To stop your blood from clotting like jelly!
Your body defense team spots the trick right away!
Guard cells blast out an emergency histamine alarm!
That alarm makes the puffy red bump and crazy itch!
Fun fact: only female mosquitoes drink blood for eggs!
Hold ice on bites instead of scratching—subscribe BabyBeats Rhymo!
